Because each recursive call goes down one level in the order-statistic tree, the total time for OS-SELECT is at worst proportional to the height of the tree. Since the tree is a red-black tree, its height is ${\cal O}(\lg n)$ , where $n$ is the number of nodes. Thus, the running time of OS-SELECT is ${\cal O}(\lg n)$ for a dynamic set of $n$ elements.
